questions.prompt: You're drafting a follow-up to an applicant who hasn't responded in a week. Which of the following prompts is safe to paste into a general-purpose AI chatbot?
choices: 'Draft a follow-up to Maria Gonzalez (SSN 555-12-3456) about her $50k application — she hasn't responded since 5/3.'
'Draft a polite, firm follow-up to a small-business applicant who hasn't responded in 7 business days about missing documentation. Under 100 words.'
'Here's the full email thread with the applicant — draft a follow-up that picks up where this left off.' (thread pasted below)
'Draft a follow-up about loan #LN-2024-08813 in our system.'
questions.explanation: The second prompt describes the situation without identifying the applicant or the loan. The first pastes an SSN. The third pastes a full thread that almost certainly contains identifying data. The fourth references a Kapitus internal loan number, which is also identifying when combined with anything else.

questions.prompt: An applicant submitted 3 of 4 bank statements and you need the fourth. You want AI to help you draft the follow-up. Which version of the prompt is best?
choices: 'Draft a follow-up to Smith's Auto Repair about their missing November 2025 bank statement for their $40k working capital application.'
'Draft a short, warm follow-up to a small-business applicant who is missing one month of bank statements. Acknowledge they're busy. Under 80 words.'
'Draft an email demanding the November bank statement immediately or we will close the file.'
'Pull the missing-document follow-up template from my last email and rewrite it for this applicant.'
questions.explanation: Option B uses the placeholder pattern — no business name, no specific month, no loan amount — and still produces a usable draft. A leaks identifying details. C is too harsh for a first follow-up and the situation type wasn't specified. D asks the chatbot to retrieve something it has no access to, which it will fabricate.

questions.prompt: After AI drafts your follow-up email, what is the right final step before sending?
choices: Send it as-is — the model already produced clean, professional text
Forward the draft to your manager for approval on every applicant email
Paste it into the applicant's record in Kapitus's system, add the applicant's real name and details, then send from your email client
Send the draft back to the AI and ask it to 'verify it complies with ECOA' before sending
questions.explanation: The drafting happens generically inside the AI tool; the personalization happens inside Kapitus's systems where the data already lives. Asking AI to verify ECOA compliance is exactly the kind of decision-making AI should not do — that comes in lesson 3.
